description: A project running Scrum cadence over dev-cycle delivery. Both playbooks are admitted by uses; the work-item slot is bound to dev-cycle's story and the delivery slot to dev-cycle itself; the scrum orchestrator is the root and dev-cycle's orchestrator keeps story-level states. Only this file, read at its committed revision, enables automatic spawns, binds people, delegates the estimate fields (by binding the work-item slot), bounds the elements in progress, and sets effort floors and the data policy. As a PC1 demo it sets no signature policy: signed board acts arrive with the waggle amendment (CM2), and before that a required signature would leave the sponsor's states unleavable (spec section 4.2). Its check sets run locally (task-board.config.json).

story.description: Difference only: stories carry the two estimates the work-item slot requires. They stay under their epic; sprints hold them by membership link.
